b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line HTTP downloader with retry support.

## Usage

```
tinydl <url> [options]
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | What to download (positional argument) |
| `-o`, `--output` | File to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | No progress output |

## Examples

Download to stdout:

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip
```

Download to a file:

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip -o file.zip
```

Quiet mode (suppress byte count):

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip -q -o file.zip
```
'
